import_batches_completion_check.name: import_batches_completion_check
import_batches_completion_check.value: ("import_batches"."status" = 'processing' AND "import_batches"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("import_batches"."status" <> 'processing' AND "import_batches"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

import_records_source_file_id_check.name: import_records_source_file_id_check
import_records_source_file_id_check.value: length(trim("import_records"."source_file_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND instr("import_records"."source_file_id", '/') = 0 AND instr("import_records"."source_file_id", char(92)) = 0

import_records_target_check.name: import_records_target_check
import_records_target_check.value: ("import_records"."status" = 'inserted' AND "import_records"."information_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_records"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("import_records"."status" = 'pending' AND "import_records"."information_id" IS NULL AND "import_records"."processed_at" IS NULL) OR ("import_records"."status" IN ('rejected', 'ignored') AND "import_records"."information_id" IS NULL AND "import_records"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)

ticket_operation_events_state_check.name: ticket_operation_events_state_check
ticket_operation_events_state_check.value: "ticket_operation_events"."next_state" IN ('in_progress', 'pending', 'normalized', 'closed') AND ("ticket_operation_events"."previous_state" IS NULL OR "ticket_operation_events"."previous_state" IN ('in_progress', 'pending', 'normalized', 'closed'))

ticket_operations_dates_check.name: ticket_operations_dates_check
ticket_operations_dates_check.value: ("ticket_operations"."state" <> 'normalized' OR "ticket_operations"."normalized_at" IS NOT NULL) AND (("ticket_operations"."state" = 'closed' AND "ticket_operations"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ticket_operations"."state" <> 'closed' AND "ticket_operations"."closed_at" IS NULL))

ticket_rfos_completion_check.name: ticket_rfos_completion_check
ticket_rfos_completion_check.value: "ticket_rfos"."completion" IN ('pending', 'completed') AND (("ticket_rfos"."completion" = 'pending' AND "ticket_rfos"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("ticket_rfos"."completion" = 'completed' AND "ticket_rfos"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_rfos"."normalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_rfos"."investigation" = 'confirmed' AND length(trim("ticket_rfos"."technical_description")) > 0 AND length(trim("ticket_rfos"."solution")) > 0))
